jobs.title: Hardware Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

As an Engineering Program Manager on our Hardware team, you will lead the development and execution of cutting-edge new hardware programs. You’ll steer our cross-functional efforts from prototype to production and guide the bring-up of new products on new factory lines. You’ll thrive at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, operations, and product management. This is a full-time, in-person role based in our San Mateo, CA office.

What You'll Do

- Lead end-to-end product development efforts; steer new programs from requirements definition through to validation, certification, ramp-up, and sustaining

- Work closely with EE, ME, FW, and ID team members to craft and track program schedules and coordinate all deliverables

- Leverage your engineering foundation to de-risk development and clear hurdles related to testing, line bring-up, SOPs, factory flow, yield, and more

- Lead a wide variety of weekly meetings including vendor calls, internal team updates, and presentations with key leadership team members

- Own the build plan and unit allocation leading up to product launches

- Coordinate with Engineering, Product Managers, and Supply Chain team members to define and execute the launch plan

- Serve as the key point of contact for an international network of manufacturing partners

- Drive vendors towards aggressive schedules and ambitious objectives

- Guide compliance efforts, sustaining work, and post-launch failure analysis efforts

What You Bring

- B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields

- Strong technical knowledge of electrical design, validation and manufacturing; SMT exposure is a plus

- 3+ years of experience in developing and manufacturing new electronics products

- Must have completed at least one full hardware development cycle through product launch; FATP exposure is a major plus

- 3+ years of experience working with an overseas hardware supply chain

- Excellent organizational skills and written and verbal communication; fluency in Mandarin is a plus

- Flexible and adaptive in a fast-paced startup environment

- Ability to travel internationally up to 20%

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

- Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

- Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

- Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

- Expanded mental health support

- Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

- Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

- Professional development stipend

- Fertility Stipend

- Wellness/fitness benefits

- Healthy lunches provided daily

- Commuter benefits

Additional Information

- We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa.

This is a high-visibility, co-selling, and partner-hunting role tasked with building out our NSW partner ecosystem to drive exponential growth. You will take end-to-end ownership of regional channel strategy, actively activating tier-1 Systems Integrators (SIs), top IT VARs, and regional distributors to generate net-new, partner-sourced enterprise deal registrations while displacing legacy, entrenched hardware incumbents.

Our mission is clear: to protect people and places in a privacy-sensitive way. Verkada’s cloud-based technology is transforming physical security across industries like healthcare, education, retail, government, and industrial infrastructure. In this role, you will bridge the gap between enterprise IT SaaS economics and physical security deployment, positioning Verkada into major multi-year RFPs, infrastructure master service agreements (MSAs), and large-scale enterprise projects across NSW.

Location & Travel

This position is based in Sydney, New South Wales, with regular travel across the state for partner enablement sessions, executive partner meetings, joint customer site walkthroughs, and channel ecosystem events, as well as occasional interstate or international travel.

While you have the flexibility to work remotely across NSW, you will have full access to Verkada’s workspace in Sydney, which we actively encourage our team to use for team collaboration, deal strategy, partner workshops, and joint customer engagements.

The Verkada Chanel Motion & Go-To-Market Engine

Our GTM channel engine combines executive alliance management, dedicated joint pipeline creation, field marketing support, structured sales execution, and strong co-selling leverage.

- Partner-Sourced Pipeline Generation: You work directly with partners, solution engineers, and business development teams to hunt net-new business, driving partner-sourced deal registrations as your primary commercial metric.

- Tier-1 SI & VAR Activation: You build and execute targeted account-mapping strategies with elite systems integrators, top national IT VARs, and strategic technology distributors to secure executive mindshare and elevate Verkada to preferred-vendor status.

- Early Infrastructure & RFP Influence: You engage partner consulting, pre-sales, and solution design teams early to get Verkada written into major enterprise and government project specifications prior to public tenders.

- AE Co-Selling Force Multiplier: You partner closely with Verkada Account Executives (AEs) to run structured joint-mapping sessions, aligning partner account managers with internal sales reps to scale market coverage across NSW.

- Bridging IT SaaS & Physical Security: Verkada’s unified, cloud-native platform replaces fragmented legacy systems. You enable IT VARs (who want software margins) with specialised installation ecosystems, while educating traditional integrators on recurring SaaS economics and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) advantages.

What You’ll Do

- Territory Channel Strategy & Execution: Own, build, and execute a comprehensive channel business plan for New South Wales, prioritising key partner accounts and alliance ecosystems to consistently exceed quarterly and annual partner-attributed revenue targets.

- Partner-Sourced Deal Registration Acceleration: Actively co-sell with partner sales teams to identify, qualify, and register net-new enterprise opportunities, driving high deal velocity from initial lead to close.

- Executive Relationship & Alliance Building: Lead C-suite and VP-level meetings across the NSW partner community, cultivate internal Partner Champions, and build compelling business cases to secure long-term partner investment and mindshare.

- Joint Account Mapping & Field Execution: Drive structured joint-mapping sessions between partner sales teams and Verkada Enterprise AEs, executing targeted account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns and regional partner events across NSW.

- RFP & Project Specification Management: Engage partner architecture teams early to influence large-scale enterprise infrastructure designs and RFPs (hundreds to thousands of endpoints) well before public release.

- Ecosystem Installation Enablement: Connect high-volume IT VARs with specialised cabling and physical installation ecosystem partners to remove deployment friction and enable partners to own massive enterprise deals confidently.

- Partner Enablement & Operational Discipline: Drive disciplined partner portal adoption, deal registration accuracy, joint pipeline forecasting, and strong CRM hygiene aligned with enterprise channel sales methodology.

- Field Presence & Office Collaboration: Maintain an active presence in the field across NSW while utilising our Sydney office space to collaborate with regional teammates, partner leadership, and joint customer teams.

What You Bring

- Experience: 10+ years of quota-carrying channel sales, partner management, or alliance leadership experience within enterprise software, networking, cybersecurity, or cloud infrastructure, with a proven track record of driving partner-sourced pipelines.

- NSW Ecosystem Authority: Active, established network and trusted C-suite/VP relationships across major NSW Tier-1 Systems Integrators, national IT VARs, cloud consultancies, and top-tier regional distributors.

- Hunter Mentality & Co-Selling Mastery: Demonstrated success actively hunting alongside partner sales reps to generate net-new deal registrations, rather than passively managing inbound partner portals or quote requests.

- Enterprise RFP & Project Capability: Track record of influencing large-scale infrastructure deployments, master service agreements (MSAs), and complex multi-stakeholder enterprise buying committees (CIO, CISO, Facilities, Procurement).

- Commercial & SaaS Acumen: Deep understanding of SaaS recurring revenue models, total cost of ownership (TCO) positioning, and hardware/software margin structures for partner business models.

- Cross-Domain Adaptability: Background in enterprise SaaS, networking/security, cloud platforms, or physical security. Ability to bridge the gap between pure-play IT VARs and traditional physical security integrators.

- Executive Polish & Influence: High energy, grit, and executive presence with the confidence to run strategic planning sessions with C-level partner executives and lead complex joint negotiations.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Why Verkada?

- Product-Market Fit: Verkada’s cloud-based B2B physical security platform is transforming industries such as healthcare, retail, government, and enterprise, solving real, urgent problems for our customers.

- Experienced Founders & Agile Leadership: Led by a team with deep industry expertise and a track record of scaling high-growth companies, enabling fast decision-making and innovation.

- Top VC Backing & Massive Growth: Verkada has raised $800M+ from leading investors, fuelling rapid expansion and offering unparalleled career opportunities in a high-growth environment.

Our marketing team prides itself on having an experimental mindset to unlock new ways to drive revenue and scaling them quickly with a data driven mindset. Behind all this lies the need to architect automations, integrations and scale processes. As the leader of the marketing operations team, you will hire and manage a team of high-performing builders who can take ambiguous problems and build solutions that stand the test of time. This role will report into our Senior Director of Growth Engineering.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our HQ in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

- Hire and manage a higher performance marketing operations team that can scale to multiple teams long-term (including campaign ops, architecture, data cleanliness and so on).

- You’ll be the point person for all demand generation campaign operations and new implementations.

- You’ll oversee the strategy and acquisition of our marketing tools, workflows, and automations required to scale our new lead acquisition methods.

- You’ll obsess over the operations of our lead ingestion to maximize the efficiency of every lead.

- You’ll build advanced automations via platforms such as Workato/AWS/Retool/etc that will work with existing sales/marketing platforms like Marketo/Salesforce to achieve a higher level of operational efficiency.

- You'll become obsessed with ensuring everything within your sphere of influence is completely automated and designed for scale.

- Research, negotiate and purchase net-new software tools that can help drive impact with a skeptical yet experimental mindset.

- Build a waterfall process to maximize the purchase of these net new leads from databases while minimizing cost and enrich leads with missing data needed for proper routing in our 20M+ contact database.

- This role is highly cross-functional: you’ll work with executives, operations, engineering, analytics, brand, sales, and more to improve marketing campaigns, prioritize projects, and ensure alignment.

- 7-15 years of operations / engineering / marketing operations / product management or relevant experience.

- Strong ability to take ambiguous problems and architect hacky and scalable solutions by integrating pre-built tools like Workato or engineering with low-code software.

- Strong ability to operationalize processes at scale.

- Strong ability to negotiate and manage multiple vendors simultaneously.

- Impeccable analytical and conceptual problem-solving skills.

- Experience working with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving startup or a hyper growth environment.

- Experience with SQL, ETL/data pipelines, excel, and BI Tools (Looker or equivalent in order to properly query data sets for data cleanliness or email campaigns) highly preferred.

At Verkada, we push traditional boundaries, and our B2B growth efforts are no exception. We’re looking for a Digital GTM Manager to join our high-performing marketing team—a group with educational backgrounds from Stanford, Princeton, and MIT, and professional experience spanning investment banking, consulting, and engineering.

As a Senior Digital Growth Manager, JAPAC, you will be responsible for driving customer acquisition through marketing campaigns across a multitude of channels, which may include Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, podcasts, and others. You will manage a large quarterly budget and will oversee campaign planning, ideation, and execution to drive massive impact on the top line of the company.

Reporting directly to the Senior Marketing Director, JAPAC you will work within the JAPAC growth team and alongside regional stakeholders to build and scale our digital growth engine. This is a role for a smart, curious digital generalist who thinks like a strategist and executes like a founder. You'll sit at the intersection of product marketing, creative, and digital — interviewing stakeholders, synthesizing insights, building campaign theses, and personally running the plays to bring them to life. You will be expected to think from first principles (revenue, business impact, and product-market fit), bring a technical mindset to how our channels and campaigns are built, and spearhead pipeline-generating initiatives across our most important segments and verticals.

As our supply chain continues to evolve with the growing business, we’re looking for a Supply Chain Manager for Aftermarket Operations to own the strategy and outcomes for our products' full post-sale lifecycle — refurbishment, spare parts, end-of-service, and non-revenue inventory. You'll manage key vendor relationships directly, make planning and disposition calls in your areas, and partner closely with engineering and quality teams to support failure analysis on warranty returns.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our office in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

- Refurb Strategy & Vendor Ownership: Own the strategy for which products get refurbished and where, and when to sunset a product from the program. Directly manage our primary refurbishment vendor relationship and own production planning and prioritization across refurb sites to keep throughput aligned with demand.

- Refurb Quality & Production Oversight: Own quality control standards for refurbished units and drive resolution when quality or output falls short. Partner with internal stakeholders to manage the day-to-day operations.

- Spare Parts Program Ownership: Own spare parts strategy end-to-end — from setup and stocking decisions through fulfillment — including the internal and external catalog and ordering experience. Define the spares approach for products approaching or past end-of-service.

- End-of-Service Strategy: Own the strategy and operational execution for transitioning products through end-of-service, balancing customer impact, cost, and inventory exposure.

- Non-Revenue Inventory & Disposition: Own the KPIs for non-revenue and returned inventory turnaround, and set the disposition rules that determine how returned inventory gets processed, resold, or retired. Drive fulfillment of non-revenue demand across the business.

- Warranty Program Support: Serve as the supply chain counterpart to quality and engineering teams on warranty returns — helping stand up and refine triage processes at our refurb center as needs evolve, and ensuring engineering gets the units they need for deeper investigation without delay.

What You Bring

- Experience: 4+ years in reverse logistics, aftermarket operations, refurbishment, or a closely related supply chain discipline.

- Vendor & Partner Management: Track record of managing an external operational partner directly — setting expectations, holding performance to standard, and resolving issues in real time.

- Strategic Ownership: A track record of taking a broad, open-ended mandate from leadership and shaping it into a concrete plan yourself — including bringing your own point of view on the right approach, not just executing steps someone else defined.

- Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to drive outcomes through people who don't report to you — coordinating across warehouse, engineering, quality, and other operational teams to keep shared work moving.

- Data Fluency: Comfortable defining a KPI, pulling your own data to support a decision, and using data to catch problems before they become escalations.

About the Role

Our team drives global demand and supply planning across all hardware product lines, optimizing forward and reverse inventory across regional warehouses to fulfill customer demand.

As our planning systems and processes continue to evolve with the growing business and the data layer that connects them, we're looking for a data steward to own the foundational data engine and operational processes powering our end-to-end planning ecosystem. You'll build, monitor, and maintain the connected data flows that our planners, cross-functional stakeholders, and external suppliers all depend on to drive daily execution.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our office in San Mateo, CA 5 days a week.

What You'll Do

- Foundational Data & Pipeline Ownership: Own and govern the core data layer and automated pipelines powering our planning processes — including item master data, lead times, and purchase orders — as it flows between systems. Build and maintain reliable, reusable datasets to ensure high-integrity data flows and reliable system syncs across product lines, regional warehouses, and external suppliers.

- System Health & Incident Triage: Serve as the first line of defense for planning pipeline failures and system discrepancies. Rapidly trace data sync errors, diagnose root causes across connected platforms, and drive fixes with internal/external partners.

- Data Operations & Refresh Execution: Own and run the operational cadence that keeps planning data trustworthy over time. Drive recurring data load and refresh schedules to completion, enforce automated quality checks, manage change control for data updates, and convert manual, repetitive data workflows into scalable, automated processes.

- Reporting & Analytics: Partner with team members to build operational dashboards that power day-to-day execution. Collaborate with supply chain leadership to define impact metrics and transform raw data into actionable insights.
